content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make a fresh new loaf of bread, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Measure the bread flour (2 minutes)
Step 2. Sift the flour into a large bowl (3 minutes)
Step 3. Create a well in the center of the dry ingredients (30 seconds)
Step 4. Dissolve sugar in warm water (2 minutes)
Step 5. Mix the yeast mixture into the flour (5 minutes)
Step 6. Knead the dough by hand (10 minutes)
Step 7. Oil the inside of a large ceramic bowl (1 minute)
Step 8. Check the temperature of the water (30 seconds)
Step 9. Prepare the salt (1 minute)
Step 10. Clear a large workspace on the counter (5 minutes)
Step 11. Test the yeast for viability (10 minutes)
Step 12. Calibrate the kitchen scale (2 minutes)
Step 13. Lightly flour the proofing basket (2 minutes)
Step 14. Cover the dough with a damp cloth (30 seconds)
Step 15. Clean the mixing spoon (2 minutes)
Step 16. Remove the loaf from the oven (1 minute)
Step 17. Whisk the salt into the flour (1 minute)
Step 18. Set the timer for the first rise (1 minute)
Step 19. Activate the dry yeast (10 minutes)
Step 20. Sanitize the mixing area (10 minutes)
Step 21. Prepare the egg wash (3 minutes)
Step 22. Buy a fresh bag of bread flour (1 hour)
Step 23. Add a pinch of diastatic malt powder (30 seconds)
Step 24. Wash the mixing bowl (5 minutes)
Step 25. Clean up the flour spills on the floor (5 minutes)
Step 26. Select the best baking stone (2 minutes)
Step 27. Rinse the measuring cups (3 minutes)
Step 28. Score the top of the dough (1 minute)
Step 29. Preheat the baking stone (45 minutes)
Step 30. Check the room temperature (1 minute)
Step 31. Perform the windowpane test on the dough (2 minutes)
Step 32. Let the dough rise in a warm spot (1.5 hours)
Step 33. Place the loaf on a cooling rack (30 seconds)
Step 34. Punch down the risen dough (1 minute)
Step 35. Shape the dough into a boule (5 minutes)
Step 36. Dust the top of the dough with rice flour (30 seconds)
Step 37. Melt a tablespoon of butter (2 minutes)
Step 38. Grease the loaf pan (2 minutes)
Step 39. Measure the warm water (1 minute)
Step 40. Steam the oven with a water tray (5 minutes)
Step 41. Locate the oven mitts (1 minute)
Step 42. Set the oven temperature (1 minute)
Step 43. Transfer the dough to the oiled bowl (2 minutes)
Step 44. Soften the honey for the dough (3 minutes)
Step 45. Scrape the dough off the counter (2 minutes)
Step 46. Bloom the yeast in the warm water (10 minutes)
Step 47. Sieve the whole wheat flour portion (2 minutes)
Step 48. Preheat the oven (20 minutes)
Step 49. Organize all ingredients on the counter (10 minutes)
Step 50. Warm the mixing bowl with hot water (3 minutes)
Step 51. Wash the kneading surface (5 minutes)
Step 52. Let the shaped loaf undergo a second rise (45 minutes)
Step 53. Weigh the total dough mass (2 minutes)
Step 54. Divide the dough into equal portions (5 minutes)
Step 55. Retrieve the heavy-duty mixer (2 minutes)
Step 56. Inspect the oven seals (5 minutes)
Step 57. Lightly oil your hands (1 minute)
Step 58. Scrub the baking stone (10 minutes)
Step 59. Fold the dough gently (3 minutes)
Step 60. Bake the bread until golden brown (35 minutes)
